criteria.description: No agent run flagged the task as unfair or broken
criteria.label: Fair task

criteria.description: At least 1 agent run must solve the problem
criteria.label: Solvable

criteria.description: Median of successful agent runs: ≥2 files, ≥20 messages, ≥200 LOC
criteria.label: Long-horizon

criteria.description: Cheat rate must be below 20% (across all agents)
criteria.label: No cheating

criteria.description: No run should be blocked by environment or verifier issues
criteria.label: No environment blockers

criteria.description: Passing runs must hold up under the false-positive review panel
criteria.guidance: The panel upheld the pass but flagged caveats — a dissenting judge, a run it couldn't review, or an inconclusive verdict. Not blocking; a reviewer may want to read the panel notes.
criteria.label: No false positives
